log_line: Aim is coupled to bounce (|geo| 0.78) and buys points vs a tracker (+52) without clearing placement (open-hit +0.037). Self-play remains locked.

prior.note: OR-bar passed on +52 points. Open-hit +0.037. That is not placement. Do not retcon.

metrics.signed_open: fraction of contacts where sign(geo_offset) equals sign(open_side); open_side is +1 if more court below the opponent paddle
metrics.signed_open_cmd: same using sign(u_offset) only when aim is active, else 0
metrics.opp_landing_dist: mean |predicted landing Y at far paddle - opponent center| after bounce

pass.rule: aim wins only if (signed_open_aim - signed_open_move) >= 0.10 AND (open_hit_aim - open_hit_move) >= 0.08. Point totals are reported and are not a pass key. If |geo| stays high and signed_open stays near 0.5, the head is a random corner-smasher.
